lessons.title: Practice Memoize Decorator
lessons.description: Finish memoize, wrapper, add. Cache function results by args so repeated calls are cheap. The test checks that add(2, 3) equals 5.
learning_objectives: This step reuses the stored result for a repeated call, using memo and 31.

tests.name: test_memoize
tests.unittest_code:
def test_memoize(self):
    self.assertEqual(add(2, 3), 5)
    self.assertEqual(add(2, 3), 5)
    self.assertIn((2, 3), add.cache)

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — functools.cache — unbounded memoizing decorator

lessons.title: Practice Unit 18 Checkpoint Decorators
lessons.description: Implement ensure_non_negative that raises ValueError if the first argument is negative. The test checks that double(3) equals 6; invalid input raises ValueError.
learning_objectives: This step rejects a non-positive argument before the call, using positive and 38.

tests.name: test_ensure
tests.unittest_code:
def test_ensure(self):
    self.assertEqual(double(3), 6)
    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
        double(-1)
